RESEARCH STATUS

What these results support

  • Synthetic checksThe in-app challenge suite tests known examples; it does not estimate field performance on new laws.
  • Source offsetsEvidence spans can be checked against supplied text; source authority is separate.
  • Exploratory modelsThe paper reports two external sentence-classification tasks, not end-to-end extraction.
  • Conditional proofZ3 checks manually normalized rules under stated assumptions.

RESEARCH RECORD

What we tested
and what remains

The preprint reports two external sentence-classification probes of the rule baseline. The app also includes source-offset checks and a conditional Z3 prototype. Neither is an end-to-end legal contradiction benchmark.

CURRENT QUESTION

How far can explicit modality cues take us before legal function and context break the rule baseline?

Five-class deontic proxyRegulatory-function proxyFailure audit
IMPLEMENTED

Evidence-linked records

Clause-level modality and fields with exact offsets into supplied text, plus human review events.

MEASURED

External classification

Two released EU datasets, grouped folds, simple learned baselines, and explicit task boundaries.

PROTOTYPE

Rule feasibility

Z3 checks two manually normalized rules and returns a witness or unsatisfiable core.

02

Next study gates

Planned work; no held-out obligation corpus is bundled.

SCOPE OF EVIDENCE

Keep the tasks separate

The external scores measure sentence labels. The synthetic suite checks software behavior. Obligation spans, reviewer benefit, and real-law contradiction accuracy still need independent gold data.
